dev.title: Developer options
dev.sendTdlibDesc: Paste a JSON request (e.g. {'{'}"_":"getMe"{'}'}) or type a method name (e.g. getMe). Results print to the console. Use with care.
dev.logUpdatesDesc: Log updates to the console and show recent tdlib-update entries below
dev.waitingUpdate: Waiting for update events… (they appear after interacting with Telegram)
dev.showCopyJsonDesc: Show "Copy raw JSON" debug items in chat list, message context menu, and profile "More" (chat / user / userFull / supergroup / basic group / secret chat, etc.)
dev.crashLogDesc: Records global errors, unhandled promises, bootstrap failures, and #app cleared events (localStorage: tdgram-crash-log)
dev.openDevtoolsDesc: Open the frontend F12 developer tools
dev.langTestDesc: Enter text to check language detection and whether it should be translated (local model, no network)
dev.langTestPh: Paste or type text to check…
dev.optionStatusDesc: Options from the TDLib cache. updateOption pushes merge into this list automatically and highlight the changed entry — no manual refresh needed.
dev.optionStatusEmpty: No cached options yet (they appear as you interact with Telegram)

optionDocs.always_parse_markdown: If true, text entities will be automatically parsed in all inputMessageText objects.
optionDocs.disable_animated_emoji: If true, animated emoji will be disabled and shown as plain emoji.
optionDocs.disable_contact_registered_notifications: If true, notifications about the user's contacts who have joined Telegram will be disabled. User will still receive the corresponding message in the private chat. getOption needs to be called explicitly to fetch the latest value of the option, changed from another device.
optionDocs.disable_network_statistics: Since TDLib 1.8.24. If true, network statistics are completely disabled.
optionDocs.disable_persistent_network_statistics: If true, persistent network statistics are disabled, which significantly reduces disk usage.
optionDocs.disable_sent_scheduled_message_notificat: If true, notifications about outgoing scheduled messages that were sent will be disabled.
optionDocs.disable_time_adjustment_protection: If true, protection from external time adjustment is disabled, which significantly reduces disk usage.
optionDocs.disable_top_chats: If true, support for top chats and statistics collection is disabled.
optionDocs.ignore_background_updates: If true, allows skipping all updates received while the TDLib instance was not running. The option does nothing if the database or secret chats are used.
optionDocs.ignore_default_disable_notification: If true, the disable_notification value specified in the request is always used instead of the default value.
optionDocs.ignore_file_names: Since TDLib 1.8.24. If true, document file names are ignored and numerical names are used instead.
optionDocs.ignore_inline_thumbnails: If true, prevents file thumbnails sent by the server along with messages from being saved on the disk.
optionDocs.ignore_platform_restrictions: If true, chat and message restrictions specific to the currently used operating system are ignored.
optionDocs.ignore_sensitive_content_restrictions: If true, sensitive content is shown on all user devices. getOption needs to be called explicitly to fetch the latest value of the option, changed from another device.
optionDocs.is_paid_reaction_anonymous: TDLib 1.8.36-1.8.44. If true, added paid reactions are anonymous by default. If false, they are non-anonymous.
optionDocs.language_pack_database_path: Path to a database for storing language pack strings, so that this database can be shared between different accounts. By default, language pack strings are stored only in memory. Changes of value of this option are applied only after TDLib restart, so it should be set before call to setTdlibParameters.
optionDocs.language_pack_id: Identifier of the currently used language pack from the current localization target.
optionDocs.localization_target: Name for the current localization target (for example, "android", "android_x", "ios", "macos", "tdesktop", "unigram", "web", "webz").
optionDocs.message_unload_delay: The maximum time messages are stored in memory before they are unloaded, 60-86400 seconds. Defaults to 60 for users and 1800 for bots.
optionDocs.notification_group_count_max: The maximum number of notification groups to be shown simultaneously, 0-25.
optionDocs.notification_group_size_max: The maximum number of simultaneously shown notifications in a group, 1-25. Defaults to 10.
optionDocs.online: Online status of the current user.
optionDocs.prefer_ipv6: If true, IPv6 addresses will be preferred over IPv4 addresses.
optionDocs.process_pinned_messages_as_mentions: Since TDLib 1.8.24. If true, all pinned messages are treated as mentions even when posted without notifying chat members.
optionDocs.use_pfs: If true, Perfect Forward Secrecy is enabled for interaction with the Telegram servers for cloud chats.
optionDocs.use_quick_ack: If true, quick acknowledgement is enabled for outgoing messages.
optionDocs.use_storage_optimizer: If true, the background storage optimizer is enabled.
optionDocs.utc_time_offset: A UTC time offset used for splitting messages by days. The option is reset automatically on each TDLib instance launch, so it needs to be set manually only if the time offset is changed during execution.
optionDocs.active_story_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.24. The maximum number of active stories posted by the current user.
optionDocs.added_shareable_chat_folder_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.24. The maximum number of added shareable chat folders for the current user.
optionDocs.added_text_composition_style_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.65. The maximum number of added custom text composition styles.
optionDocs.affiliate_program_commission_per_mille_m: Since TDLib 1.8.41. The maximum commission that can be used for an affiliate program.
Since TDLib 1.8.41. The minimum commission that can be used for an affiliate program.
optionDocs.animation_search_bot_username: Username of a bot which can be used in inline mode for animations search.
optionDocs.anti_spam_bot_user_id: Since TDLib 1.8.24. User identifier of the Telegram Anti-Spam bot.
optionDocs.authentication_token: An authentication token to be used on subsequent authorizations.
optionDocs.authorization_date: Point in time (Unix timestamp) when authorization was received.
optionDocs.basic_group_size_max: The maximum number of members in a basic group.
optionDocs.bio_length_max: Since TDLib 1.8.24. The maximum allowed length of the current user's bio.
optionDocs.bot_media_preview_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.34. The maximum number of media previews that can be added for a bot.
optionDocs.bot_verification_custom_description_leng: Since TDLib 1.8.42. The maximum length of custom description for verification provided by a third-party organization.
optionDocs.business_chat_link_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.28. The maximum number of created short chat links by a Telegram Business account.
optionDocs.business_start_page_message_length_max: Since TDLib 1.8.28. The maximum allowed length of the start page message of a Telegram Business account.
optionDocs.business_start_page_title_length_max: Since TDLib 1.8.28. The maximum allowed length of the start page title of a Telegram Business account.
optionDocs.call_connect_timeout_ms: The maximum time to wait for call connection creation to be passed to tgcalls.
optionDocs.call_packet_timeout_ms: The maximum time to wait for call packet delivery to be passed to tgcalls.
optionDocs.can_accept_calls: Since TDLib 1.8.48. If true, the user can accept calls from this device.
optionDocs.can_archive_and_mute_new_chats_from_unkn: If true, new chats from unknown users can be automatically archived and muted via archiveChatListSettings.
optionDocs.can_enable_paid_messages: Since TDLib 1.8.46. If true, the user can enable paid messages.
optionDocs.can_gift_stars: Since TDLib 1.8.34. If true, Telegram Stars can be gifted to other users.
optionDocs.can_ignore_sensitive_content_restriction: If true, the option "ignore_sensitive_content_restrictions" can be changed.
optionDocs.can_preload_weather: Since TDLib 1.8.34. If true, the current weather must be preloaded before adding the media area to the story. Otherwise, weather must be loaded only after the user has chosen the weather media area.
optionDocs.can_set_new_chat_privacy_settings: Since TDLib 1.8.28. If true, the current user can change privacy settings for new chats.
optionDocs.can_use_login_passkey: Since TDLib 1.8.59. If true, passkey can be used to log in and new passkeys can be added.
optionDocs.can_use_text_entities_in_story_caption: Since TDLib 1.8.24. If true, the current user can use text entities in story captions.
optionDocs.can_withdraw_chat_revenue: Since TDLib 1.8.28. If true, revenue from sponsored messages in chats can be withdrawn.
optionDocs.channel_bot_user_id: Identifier of the bot which is shown as the sender of messages sent on behalf of channels when viewed from an outdated client.
optionDocs.chat_available_reaction_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.24. The maximum number of manually chosen reactions for a chat.
optionDocs.chat_boost_level_max: Since TDLib 1.8.24. The maximum boost level available to a chat.
optionDocs.chat_folder_chosen_chat_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.24. The maximum number of always included or excluded chats in a chat folder for the current user.
optionDocs.chat_folder_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.24. The maximum number of chat folders that the current user can have.
optionDocs.chat_folder_invite_link_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.24. The maximum number of shareable chat folders with owned invite links.
optionDocs.chat_folder_new_chats_update_period: Since TDLib 1.8.24. The minimum interval between calls to getChatFolderNewChats in shareable chat folders.
optionDocs.checklist_task_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.51. The maximum number of tasks in a checklist.
optionDocs.checklist_task_text_length_max: Since TDLib 1.8.51. The maximum length of text of a task in a checklist.
optionDocs.checklist_title_length_max: Since TDLib 1.8.51. The maximum length of title of a checklist.
optionDocs.commit_hash: Since TDLib 1.8.24. If known, the hash of the source code commit used to build TDLib. Can be received synchronously.
optionDocs.community_bot_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.67. The maximum number of bots that can be added to a community.
optionDocs.community_chat_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.67. The maximum number of supergroups and channels that can be added to a community.
optionDocs.direct_channel_message_star_count_defaul: Since TDLib 1.8.50. Default value for the price of incoming messages in direct channels.
optionDocs.expect_blocking: If true, access to Telegram is likely blocked for the user.
optionDocs.fact_check_length_max: Since TDLib 1.8.30. The maximum allowed length of a fact-check.
optionDocs.favorite_stickers_limit: The maximum number of favorite stickers.
optionDocs.forwarded_message_count_max: The maximum number of forwarded messages per one request.
optionDocs.gift_collection_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.53. The maximum number of gift collections.
optionDocs.gift_collection_size_max: Since TDLib 1.8.54. The maximum number of gifts in a gift collection.
optionDocs.gift_premium_from_attachment_menu: Since TDLib 1.8.24. If true, a suggestion to gift Telegram Premium needs to be shown in the attachment menu if appropriate.
optionDocs.gift_premium_from_input_field: Since TDLib 1.8.24. If true, a suggestion to gift Telegram Premium needs to be shown in the input field if appropriate.
optionDocs.gift_resale_earnings_per_mille: TDLib 1.8.49-1.8.52. The amount of Telegram Stars received by the user for each 1000 Telegram Stars paid for gifts bought from them.
optionDocs.gift_resale_gram_cent_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.65. The maximum price in 1/100 of TON Gram for a gift that is available for resale.
optionDocs.gift_resale_gram_cent_count_min: Since TDLib 1.8.65. The minimum price in 1/100 of TON Gram for a gift that is available for resale.
optionDocs.gift_resale_gram_earnings_per_mille: Since TDLib 1.8.65. The amount of TON Grams received by the user for each 1000 Grams paid for gifts bought from them.
optionDocs.gift_resale_star_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.49. The maximum price in Telegram Stars for a gift that is available for resale.
optionDocs.gift_resale_star_count_min: Since TDLib 1.8.49. The minimum price in Telegram Stars for a gift that is available for resale.
optionDocs.gift_resale_star_earnings_per_mille: Since TDLib 1.8.53. The amount of Telegram Stars received by the user for each 1000 Telegram Stars paid for gifts bought from them.
optionDocs.gift_resale_toncoin_cent_count_max: TDLib 1.8.53-1.8.64. The maximum price in 1/100 of TON Gram for a gift that is available for resale.
optionDocs.gift_resale_toncoin_cent_count_min: TDLib 1.8.53-1.8.64. The minimum price in 1/100 of TON Gram for a gift that is available for resale.
optionDocs.gift_resale_toncoin_earnings_per_mille: TDLib 1.8.53-1.8.64. The amount of TON Grams received by the user for each 1000 Grams paid for gifts bought from them.
optionDocs.gift_sell_period: Since TDLib 1.8.38. The number of seconds after gift receiving for which it can be sold for Telegram Stars.
optionDocs.gift_text_length_max: Since TDLib 1.8.37. The maximum length of a message added to a sent gift.
optionDocs.giveaway_additional_chat_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.24. The maximum number of additional chats that can be added to a giveaway.
optionDocs.giveaway_boost_count_per_premium: Since TDLib 1.8.24. The number of boosts received by the channel for each giveaway prize.
optionDocs.giveaway_country_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.24. The maximum number of countries that can be added to a giveaway.
optionDocs.giveaway_duration_max: Since TDLib 1.8.24. The maximum duration of a giveaway.
optionDocs.gram_top_up_url: Since TDLib 1.8.65. The URL that can be used to top up TON Gram balance of the current user.
optionDocs.group_anonymous_bot_user_id: Identifier of the bot which is shown as the sender of anonymous messages in groups when viewed from an outdated client.
optionDocs.group_call_message_text_length_max: Since TDLib 1.8.56. The maximum length of a message text in a group call that isn't a live story.
optionDocs.group_call_participant_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.48. The maximum number of participants in a group call that is not bound to a chat.
optionDocs.is_premium: Since TDLib 1.8.24. If true, the current user is subscribed to Telegram Premium.
optionDocs.is_premium_available: Since TDLib 1.8.24. If true, the current user can subscribe to Telegram Premium. Otherwise, all premium-related features must be hidden.
optionDocs.login_passkey_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.59. The maximum number of login passkeys that can be added.
optionDocs.message_caption_length_max: The maximum length of a message caption.
optionDocs.message_reply_quote_length_max: Since TDLib 1.8.24. The maximum length of a quote from the replied message.
optionDocs.message_text_length_max: The maximum length of a message text.
optionDocs.million_gram_to_usd_rate: Since TDLib 1.8.65. The number of US dollars that can be received by selling 1000000 TON Grams on a third-party exchange.
optionDocs.million_toncoin_to_usd_rate: TDLib 1.8.52-1.8.64. The number of US dollars that can be received by selling 1000000 TON Grams on a third-party exchange.
optionDocs.monthly_sent_story_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.24. The maximum number of stories that can be posted per month by the current user.
optionDocs.notification_sound_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.24. The maximum number of saved notification sounds.
optionDocs.notification_sound_duration_max: Since TDLib 1.8.24. The maximum duration of an audio that can be used as a notification sound.
optionDocs.notification_sound_size_max: Since TDLib 1.8.24. The maximum size of the audio file that can be used as a notification sound.
optionDocs.owned_bot_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.63. The maximum number of bots that can be owned by the current user.
optionDocs.paid_group_call_message_star_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.57. The maximum number of Telegram Stars that can be set as the price for paid group call messages.
optionDocs.paid_media_message_star_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.32. The maximum price of a paid post in Telegram Stars.
optionDocs.paid_message_earnings_per_mille: Since TDLib 1.8.46. The amount of Telegram Stars received by the user or the supergroup for each 1000 Telegram Stars paid for their incoming messages.
optionDocs.paid_message_star_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.46. The maximum number of Telegram Stars that can be set as the price for paid messages.
optionDocs.paid_reaction_star_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.35. The maximum number of Telegram Stars that can be added as a paid reaction to a message in one request.
optionDocs.pending_text_message_period: Since TDLib 1.8.56. The maximum number of seconds to show a pending message from a bot.
optionDocs.photo_search_bot_username: Username of a bot which can be used in inline mode for photos search.
optionDocs.pinned_archived_chat_count_max: The maximum number of pinned cloud chats in the Archive chat list for the current user. The same amount of secret chats can be pinned locally.
optionDocs.pinned_chat_count_max: The maximum number of pinned cloud chats in the Main chat list for the current user. The same amount of secret chats can be pinned locally.
optionDocs.pinned_forum_topic_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.24. The maximum number of pinned forum topics.
optionDocs.pinned_gift_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.46. The maximum number of pinned unique gifts.
optionDocs.pinned_saved_messages_topic_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.24. The maximum number of pinned topics in Saved Messages for the current user.
optionDocs.pinned_story_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.29. The maximum number of pinned stories on a chat page.
optionDocs.poll_answer_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.50. The maximum number of options in a poll message.
optionDocs.poll_country_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.63. The maximum number of countries for which a poll can be restricted.
optionDocs.poll_open_period_max: Since TDLib 1.8.63. The maximum amount of time after which the poll may be automatically closed; in seconds.
optionDocs.premium_download_speedup: Since TDLib 1.8.28. Approximate number of times file download speed increases if the user subscribes to Telegram Premium.
optionDocs.premium_gift_boost_count: Since TDLib 1.8.24. The number of boosts obtained by gifting Telegram Premium to another user.
optionDocs.premium_upload_speedup: Since TDLib 1.8.28. Approximate number of times file upload speed increases if the user subscribes to Telegram Premium.
optionDocs.quick_reply_shortcut_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.28. The maximum number of quick reply shortcuts that can be created by a Telegram Business account.
optionDocs.quick_reply_shortcut_message_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.28. The maximum number of messages that can be added to a quick reply shortcut by a Telegram Business account.
optionDocs.rich_message_block_count_max: Since TDLib 1.8.65. The maximum number of blocks in a rich message.
optionDocs.rich_message_depth_max: Since TDLib 1.8.65. The maximum depth of nested blocks in a rich message.
